native_appkit_before_after.runtime: Original and final packaged Mac Development executables. 640x360 offscreen, window normally captured at high precision, -benchmark supplies active-game focus for these isolated offscreen positive checks. Camera reads run on the actual UE game thread; the input harness never assigns camera state.
native_appkit_before_after.input: Six buttonless native NSEvent objects created from mouse-moved CGEvents and posted via [NSApp postEvent:atStart:] into each isolated Mac process, after one neutral event at capture. UE reads native deltaX/deltaY in its normal local NSEvent monitor. A process-only test library silenced other apps’ desktop mouse movements and prevented system cursor warp and reassociation. No system-wide injection or physical hardware use.
native_appkit_before_after.measurement: UE LogPlayerInput logs before Enhanced Input and game-thread APlayerController::GetPlayerViewPoint after camera updates. Per-event direction and size checked against the first-party axis sensitivity and yaw/pitch scale. No mutations of the shipped binary. Temporary inspection library loaded into isolated test processes.

runs.build: Previous 0.3.0 package as delivered before camera fix

unfocused_control.configuration: Same final executable and injected NSEvents without -benchmark, process NSApp inactive.

viewport_method: Each positive path received synthetic buttonless pointer events in captured Slate SViewport while -benchmark supplied foreground focus. The separate negative paths ran without -benchmark in actually inactive offscreen apps. A process-local test shim suppressed unrelated desktop motion. Rotation comes from PlayerCameraManager in both cases. PIE started and ended through the editor level subsystem.
